title: P5 T2 citation-support tier RE-DESIGNED — the deterministic keyword-coverage bar RETIRED (proven false-negative-everything)
data_grounding: r160s1 ground-truth calibration: the frozen v1 keyword resolver accepts 0/18 of the corpus's genuinely-supporting prior-art papers (incl. the target's own referenced work); the v2 normalization repair also 0/18; term-source diagnostic shows generator-paraphrase terms false-negative everything (vocabulary mismatch), corpus-text terms 15/15 but circular; Crossref abstract availability 46.7% (title-only blobs). The keyword-coverage bar CANNOT validly measure citation support.
amendment: T2 = TWO independent sub-tiers (r159_p5_v2_run.py): (a) KNOWN-ITEM tier — DOI resolves via Crossref AND title fuzzy-matches (SequenceMatcher>=0.82) a REGISTERED prior-art title from the SEAL-TIME known-item registry (pre-registered ground truth, NOT served to the generator — non-circular); (b) SUPPORT-RATING tier — DOI resolves AND an independent judge (z-ai glm) rates title+abstract as SUPPORTING the generated key_mechanism; generator is tokenrouter deepseek (judge!=generator, F2-clean). Item passes iff EVERY citation resolves AND >=1 sub-tier passes.
caveat: the known-item registry MUST be sealed ground truth NOT served to the generator (else the tier is tautological); the support-rating judge MUST be != generator and R-CAL-qualified for the support task; positive/negative controls pre-registered. Forward-only; the keyword bar is retired with this dated reason (Art.8).
